Definition: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
BiblicalUsage: 1) one (number); 1a) one (number); 1b) each, every; 1c) a certain; 1d) an (indefinite article); 1e) only, once, once for all; 1f) one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one; 1g) first; 1h) eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal)
